description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the composition of the Darija Open Dataset (Version 2) across multiple data categories, and it contains six slices. The largest slice is labeled “Extra + Augmented Data” and is shown in yellow at about 45,387 (roughly one-third of the ring), followed by “Pending Translations” in green at about 43,000 (also about one-third), “Translated Sentences” in blue at about 30,000 (around one-fifth to one-quarter), and “Syntactic Roles (e.g., …)” in orange at about 23,108 (around one-sixth). Two very thin slices appear between the green and orange segments: a purple slice labeled “Semantic …” and a small red/orange slice (label not fully visible), each representing a very small fraction (well under a few percent). Numeric value labels are printed inside the larger slices, a legend with colored markers and category names appears to the upper right, and no slices are exploded or otherwise emphasized; the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the ring.
